# 06_features: model-ready tables (all generated by scripts)

* `stage1_<gauge>.csv`: one row per issue day, 77+ inputs and the next-day target. `*_forecast_inputs.csv`: the same without dropping days whose target is unknown.
* `chirps_zone_daily_raw.csv` / `chirps_daily_subcatchments.csv`: CHIRPS v3 rainfall per sub-catchment, 2014–2025.
* `stage2_grid.tif`, `stage2_cells.parquet`, `stage2_grid_meta.json`: the 100 m grid (219,017 cells) and its static layers.
* `stage2_events/<scene>.parquet`: the Stage 2 training table, one file per Sentinel-1 scene (7.8 million cell-scene rows in total). `stage2_events_summary.csv`: one line per scene.
